verdicts.evidence: At 61942e7 the regex in src/app.provider.ts only accepted b|kb|mb|gb. Commit b82551190 ("accepting tb/pb units in parseBodyLimit") widened it to b|kb|mb|gb|tb|pb (src/app.provider.ts:66).
src/modules/auth/utils/auth-cookie.utils.spec.ts did not exist at 61942e7. Commit b82551190 added it, including the test 'treats maxAge as seconds and derives Expires in milliseconds'.

Neither passthrough handler changed. PooyaRaki's 2026-06-24 reply declined the test-coverage items as 'already exercised by existing integration specs', and the bot's final review raised no further objection.

PooyaRaki declined it: 'Express did not throw on a missing Host; it produced http://undefined/…. No regression.' The 'localhost' fallback is still at src/routes/common/http/http-request.utils.ts:76, and the final bot review accepted that rationale.
At 61942e7 the middleware typed req as `IncomingMessage & { originalUrl?: string }`. Commit b82551190 changed it to the shared `RequestLike` (src/middleware/not-found-logger.middleware.ts:10,29).

PooyaRaki declined it: 'Tenderly rawBody HMAC — pre-existing, behaviour-affecting; out of scope for this PR.' tenderly-signature.guard.ts:57 still uses JSON.stringify(args.body).
PooyaRaki declined it: 'parseBodyLimit('1.5b')→1 — deliberate bytes-library parity, documented and tested.' The decimal-permitting regex and Math.floor are unchanged at src/app.provider.ts:66-73.
